args.code: (() => { try { const gc = document.getElementById('game-container'); if (!gc) return JSON.stringify({error: 'no game-container'}); const allText = gc.innerText.split(String.fromCharCode(10)).map(s => s.trim()).filter(s => s.length > 0); return JSON.stringify({allText: allText.slice(0,80)}); } catch(e) { return JSON.stringify({error: e.message}); } })()
